chain.title: Beyond Supremium
chain.desc: Advance through Mystical Agriculture first, then combine Supremium Essence around an infusion crystal to make Insanium. This addon extends the existing essence ladder.

chain.title: Prepare the Highest-Tier Plot
chain.desc: Make Insanium Farmland for your crop project. Tier-six crops still need their matching Crux beneath the farmland; the farmland alone is not enough.

chain.title: Refine an Insanium Material
chain.desc: Make an Insanium Ingot using the installed recipe. Keep this material branch separate from the special crop-growing requirements.

chain.title: An Insanium Gem
chain.desc: Upgrade a gemstone through the available recipe. Inspect its uses before investing large amounts of essence.

chain.title: A Reason to Face the Wither
chain.desc: Defeat Withers for a chance at Withering Souls. They are part of the Nether Star crop branch; an ordinary Nether Star alone does not replace them.
chain.acquisition: Mystical Agradditions 8.0.14 MobDropsHandler.onLivingDrops adds a Withering Soul item entity to Wither death drops when mob loot is enabled and the configured chance succeeds. ModConfigs defaults witheringSoulChance to 0.35; packs may change that chance.

chain.title: The Nether Star Crop's Foundation
chain.desc: Craft a Nether Star Crux and place it directly below the farmland used by the matching tier-six crop. Follow the installed seed recipe for the rest of the setup.

chain.title: Return to the Dragon
chain.desc: Obtain Dragon Scales through the addon's Ender Dragon progression. Reserve them for the Dragon Egg Crux rather than spending every rare drop immediately.

chain.title: A Foundation for Dragon Crops
chain.desc: Build the Dragon Egg Crux and place it below the matching crop's farmland. This is a separate branch from the Nether Star Crux.

chain.title: Make a Tier-Six Crop Actually Grow
chain.desc: Plant the matching Nether Star seed over its Crux and harvest it successfully. Confirm once growth works; these crops do not normally duplicate seeds when harvested.

chain.title: Turn the Harvest into Star Material
chain.desc: Use Nether Star Essence from your working crop to craft a Nether Star Shard. Follow the installed assembly recipe to turn repeated harvests into stars.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: The real tier-six extension: Insanium, farmland, Wither and dragon crux branches, and crop operation.
coverage.limitations: Checked against cached 7.0.12 JAR recipes and its bundled Mystical Agriculture guide pages. Requires Mystical Agriculture. Compatibility cruxes for absent mods and Creative Essence are deliberately excluded.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
